title: update

goal.text: Refresh the published claw-kit CLI and Cindy plugin installation.

requirements.summary: Refresh the global CLI first, refresh Cindy from the published Cindy plugin package second, then verify both installed surfaces and report exact status.
acceptanceCriteria: The published global `@veewo/claw` CLI and Cindy plugin are both refreshed.
The Cindy target is the newest stable `vcindy-*` GitHub Release that contains a matching `.cindy` asset.
The downloaded asset filename, release tag, embedded manifest, installed plugin id, enabled state, and runtime state are verified against the target version.
The result reports exact success or failure for each surface.

tasks.title: Confirm the published target version and official Cindy source
tasks.detail: Tell the user a newer claw-kit version was detected. Enumerate the official `chanyuenpang/claw-kit` GitHub Releases, ignore drafts and prereleases unless explicitly requested, filter tags beginning with `vcindy-`, compare their adapter versions numerically, and choose the newest release containing a `.cindy` asset whose filename version matches the tag. Verify the asset's embedded `ghost.json` version before changing local installs. Do not use the repository-wide `releases/latest` shortcut because another artifact family may be newer. A release workflow must publish and verify first.

tasks.title: Refresh the CLI and Cindy plugin
tasks.detail: Refresh the global CLI first from its published package. Download the selected `.cindy` asset directly from its immutable official GitHub Release URL, then open it with Cindy and accept the install/update confirmation. Enable the installed plugin id `claw-kit` if needed. Do not install from GitHub `main`, a marketplace snapshot, unpublished workspace files, or a local package. If no matching release asset exists, stop and report the missing artifact.

default.summary: The CLI and Cindy plugin refresh commands completed; verify both installed surfaces.
nextsteps: Verify the immutable GitHub Release asset, enabled plugin identity, and matching manifests.

tasks.title: Verify the CLI and Cindy plugin
tasks.detail: Run `claw --version` and `npm list -g @veewo/claw --depth=0`. Record the selected `vcindy-*` tag and immutable asset URL; verify the downloaded asset filename and embedded `ghost.json` version match that tag. Verify the installed Cindy plugin id `claw-kit` is enabled and running at the same version. Restart Cindy and start a new task before validating the loaded skill version. Report exact success or failure for both surfaces.

references.why: Preserves the direct Cindy update workflow when the claw template cannot run.
Maps Cindy update requirements to this skill package.

rules: Do not route or ask about another host; this is the Cindy update workflow.
Publish and verify the target version before release-time installation refresh.
Use only the matching `.cindy` asset from the newest stable official `vcindy-*` GitHub Release and the installed plugin id `claw-kit`.
Do not claim success unless both CLI and Cindy plugin verification pass.
